App details

Bubble Level & Inclinometer

Check whether a surface is level and measure its tilt with your phone’s sensors.

In the worksPlannedAndroid

What it’s for

Use available sensors for horizontal, vertical and two-axis leveling, slope and inclination readings, with calibration and relative zero. Accuracy depends on the device.

Main features

  • Horizontal, vertical and two-axis leveling.
  • Calibration and a relative zero point.
  • Freeze a reading for easier viewing.
  • Accuracy depends on your device and calibration.

This app is planned. The description presents documented plans, not an app available to download. The final design and app still need approval and testing; there is no announced release date.

How to use

Place the phone against a surface and choose horizontal, vertical or two-axis leveling. Read the bubble and numeric angle together. Use quick calibration on a known level surface, or the two-reading method with a 180-degree turn. Relative Zero compares a second slope with the first; Hold freezes a reading for easier viewing.

Important limits

Accuracy depends on sensors, the case, placement and calibration. Missing sensors limit the available modes. It is not a certified industrial instrument and does not measure distance.

Offline use, permissions and purchases

The planned core functions run on the device without a JN86 account. Advertising, purchases, optional downloads and external links may need an internet connection. Offline core operation does not rule out separate service data flows.

Android 7.0 or newer is the common planned baseline. Individual sensor and platform features still depend on the device.

Permissions

Core leveling uses device sensors without dangerous permission. Camera and location are not required.

Local data

Calibration, relative zero and display choices would be stored locally. Live sensor readings are temporary; no measurement history or server upload is planned.

Advertising and purchases

The plan keeps every core feature free, with banner advertising and an optional one-time Google Play purchase to remove ads. There is no subscription. Actual local prices will come from Play; advertising providers, consent choices and SDK data handling must be specified before launch.

First version and later ideas

The functions above belong to the documented plan for the first version. Features mentioned below as excluded or later ideas are not promised as current capabilities.

Quick and two-reading calibration, Relative Zero and Hold are included. Advanced axis calibration, camera overlay and measurement reports are excluded.

Availability

This app is being created. The features described here are planned; it is not yet available to download.
